hooks.name: Schema Guard
hooks.description: Mechanical schema invariants (no extend blocks, SCHEMA-5, subscription tenantId args, auth directives). Runs the hermetic schema-guard test on every save of schema.graphql and reports its output verbatim.

action.prompt: Run `npx vitest run services/api/__tests__/schema-guard.test.ts` and report the output VERBATIM. If any assertion fails, the schema edit violates a standing invariant (extend blocks are silently ignored by AppSync; SCHEMA-5 forbids tenantId in inputs; every Subscription field needs tenantId: ID!; every Query/Mutation field needs an @aws_ directive) — fix the schema before proceeding. Never weaken or delete the guard test to go green. Remember: any NEW resolver for a NEW schema field must carry an explicit node dependency on the schema in infra/lib/api-stack.ts (see the dependency loop; live 404 otherwise).
